newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PROFURN SEES LARGE VOLUMES AFTER LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: PROFURN SEES LARGE VOLUMES AFTER LATE TRADE.

text.p: South African furniture group Protea Furnishers Ltd (Profurn) saw heavy volumes on Monday following a late trade carried over from Friday by brokers HSBC Simpson McKie, dealers said.
The deal involved 13.9 million shares worth around 35 million rand.
Profurn was last up a cent at 263 cents with turnover at 35.4 million rand after opening at 255 cents.

Profurn earlier announced that the price for the re-acquisition of its debtors book from First National Bank of Southern Africa Ltd was reduced by 100 million rand. It said the 100 million rand would be used to offset a loan of that amount from FNB.
As a result interest would no longer be payable on the loan and Profurn's earnings per share for the year ending December 1997 would increase accordingly.
"I think this is positive news for them," one dealer said.
